name: Digital Logic Design: Nandrel
subtitle: Gates, K-maps, FSMs, 3D labs
shortDescription: Adaptive digital logic course with seven 3D labs: state machines, adders, K-maps, hazards and LUTs. Choose your quiz length and level. Free to study.
longDescription:
Nandrel is an adaptive Digital Logic Design course for undergraduate engineering students.

### Seven 3D labs
Step a traffic-light state machine, race two adders along a track, minimise a seven-segment decoder on a Karnaugh landscape, watch a hazard glitch on a scope, and explore flip-flop timing, LUT fabrics and signal edges. Every lab shows a live second-method check and opens its cited sources in an in-app window.

### Your level, your length
Pick 5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number of questions, from beginner to research level, adaptive or in course order. Mock exams stay ad-free.

### What is covered
Number systems, Boolean algebra, gates, Karnaugh maps, combinational building blocks, adders, flip-flops, counters, finite state machines, timing and hazards, memory, programmable logic and introductory Verilog.

Free with short ads at natural breaks, never during a timed test, with an optional monthly ad-free plan. Your progress stays on your device. No account needed.
